name: Central Zone of the Town of Angra do Heroismo in the Azores
description: Angra do Heroísmo is a port town on Terceira Island in the Azores, founded in 1478. For centuries, ships crossing the Atlantic had to stop here, and the harbour is still ringed by the massive walls of its roughly 400-year-old fortresses. Visitors can wander pastel-coloured streets and churches that have been carefully rebuilt since a damaging earthquake in 1980.
